metric_definition: Mean absolute error (MAE), balanced equally across location/day-or-night groups, then dates and satellite passes; observations within a pass are weighted by footprint area.
observation_scope: Native VIIRS satellite footprints, mainly clear-sky conditions. These are research candidates, separate from the live 40-input model. They do not establish 100 m, cloudy-condition or worldwide accuracy.

studies.change: Four inputs re-expressed as surface–air and recent-weather differences; same 31 slots and small model

expansion.description: The same small model was compared before and after adding the new development locations. Both arms use the same direct ERA5 weather inputs; the six earlier comparisons above used API-delivered weather. Every held observation and missing case is retained. These exploratory results do not qualify worldwide or 100 m accuracy.
